reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output when the cited text supports compliance — the rendered redline is identical to the originals, so no unnecessary edit was introduced.

Section 14.1 sets a finite, event-based Term (expiring on the earlier of termination under 14.2 or payment of the last Approval Payment) with no evergreen or auto-extension mechanic; the Development Term definition is likewise tied to trial completion and conclusion of Regulatory Approval efforts.

With no automatic renewal, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift language, the outcome is at least as favorable to us as the RENEWAL preferred position (extension would require mutual agreement/amendment), so there is nothing to shorten or cap.

The failed deterministic check ('non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days: number not found') is consistent with the absence of any renewal window rather than evidence of a defect; it is a heuristic miss, not a substantive failure.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes the contract type (co-development/funding) and the searches performed; retaining this as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue is correct.
